operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog does not define insertion or coordinate-level grafting of a motif into a larger protein structure.
The catalog has no operation for computing gradients as classifier-guidance control signals.
Alignment and addition do not represent computing optimal-transport distances between atoms and point-cloud points.
The catalog has no symmetry-group tessellation operation that replicates an asymmetric subunit in an energy function.
